snippet.title: New Worlds v0.3.0: Rule Your Faction!
snippet.description:
New Worlds is a space-faring universe simulation game where you navigate gravity to explore, complete missions, trade, upgrade and improve your ship fleet. Adventure to uncharted planets, to settle and develop the “New Worlds” of the last great frontier!

PLAY FREE at playnewworlds.com | Early-Access: $4.99 computerise.itch.io/newworlds

🚀 New Worlds: fly by gravity, trade between worlds, grow your fleet and settle the last great frontier.

🆕 v0.3.0 Rule Your Faction: set Taxes and Tariffs, build Megacities, and race your best time in the new Speedrun Mode.

🛒 Buy the full game on itch.io for Windows, Mac, Linux, Android and browser. Early Access buyers get a Steam key at the 1.0 launch.

🧪 Want to playtest? Email hello@computerise.games
🌐 More from the developer: computerise.games
